public_rationale: This is a conditional forecast with no deadline. It applies only if OpenAI fails to meet its obligations. On 2026-04-28, Simply Wall St, via Yahoo Finance, reported that OpenAI had reportedly missed internal user and sales targets. It said this raised questions about OpenAI's ability to honor Oracle commitments reported at up to $300b (e1). The same article reported that Oracle shares fell 8.4% over seven days amid a broader AI infrastructure sell-off (e1). It describes doubts, not an actual default, missed payment or forced renegotiation. The cited evidence does not show any such failure by 2026-10-28. Because the condition has not been shown, the forecast about Nvidia, Oracle and others cannot be scored yet.
limitations: The lack of default reports comes from searches up to the evaluation date, not a full review of counterparty filings.
Stock declines before any documented failure cannot count, because the forecast is about damage caused by a failure.
A source not used as evidence says some Oracle payments start in 2027. This timing was not verified.
